response.sql: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_count FROM district AS d LEFT JOIN client AS c ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3) SELECT district_id, region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / NULLIF(SUM(client_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 0) AS region_share, 1.0 * client_count / NULLIF(SUM(client_count) OVER (), 0) AS overall_share FROM district_counts ORDER BY overall_share DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 10;
